fill, click or submit (ADR-0014); robots.txt is read first and obeyed, and page requests are
at least one second apart (ADR-0091). Only hosts in allowedHosts are reachable.
DO NOT RUN THIS FILE FROM THE CLOUD SESSION, AND DO NOT RUN IT WITHOUT VAHID SAYING SO.

Confirmed by Vahid, 2026-09-10. Everything below about Sheffield is what its public pages
STATE, transcribed from Vahid's message with the source URL and the date he retrieved it.
None of it has been observed by this repository. The claims are what the run would confirm
or refute; the eight authentication questions are asked, not answered.
Two fields are Vahid's to supply and are NOT invented here: which course (courseName), and
the intake YEAR (all PGT master's start in September; the year is part of the submission key).
courseName: Postgraduate taught master's — course not yet chosen (Vahid's to supply)
intake: September — year not yet stated (Vahid's to supply)
routeNotes: Direct application through the university's own Postgraduate Online Application Form.
The host the form itself lives on is not known. The entry point is on www.sheffield.ac.uk;
where the login boundary falls, and on which host, is the first thing this run is for.
Sheffield's sibling form (Alternative Routes, /arpform/login.app) tells new applicants that
an email will be sent containing their login details. If the PGT form behaves the same way,
the approach is portal_issued under ADR-0020, not student_chosen. To be CONFIRMED BY
OBSERVATION, not assumed from the sibling form (Vahid, 2026-09-10).
claimsToVerify: STATED (https://sheffield.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/apply/applying, retrieved 2026-09-10): the form is in two parts; Part 1 is personal information, English language ability, previous education and employment, with mandatory fields marked * that must all be completed before Part 2 opens
STATED (same source, 2026-09-10): Part 2 is course selection — up to three courses per application
STATED (same source, 2026-09-10): supporting documents — evidence of previous qualifications, a personal statement — are uploaded into the relevant sections of the form
STATED (same source, 2026-09-10): the application is submitted only when Submit Application is clicked, and incomplete sections are prompted back at that point
STATED (same source, 2026-09-10): no application fee for PGT master's
STATED (https://www.sheffield.ac.uk/postgradapplication, retrieved 2026-09-10): this is the entry point to the Postgraduate Online Application Form
STATED (Vahid, 2026-09-10): all PGT master's start in September; there is no January or February intake
TO OBSERVE: where the login boundary falls — which pages are reachable without an account, and on which host the form lives
TO OBSERVE: whether the form issues a credential by email (portal_issued) as the sibling /arpform/login.app form states it does, or asks the applicant to choose a password (student_chosen)

TO OBSERVE, and REPORT BEFORE DECIDING: whether up to three course choices, each submitted separately, is three cases or one case with three targets (ADR-0006; the key is studentId, institutionId, courseId, intake, attemptOrdinal). Do not adapt the model to fit what you expect.
AUTH 1 — Does the applicant choose their own password at account creation?
AUTH 2 — Does the portal generate a credential and email it to them?
AUTH 3 — Is there passwordless sign-in — a magic link or emailed code?
AUTH 4 — Must the email be verified before the form is reachable?
AUTH 5 — Is MFA or a one-time code required, and where?
AUTH 6 — Is a CAPTCHA present, and where?
AUTH 7 — Does 'Forgot password' work, and does the reset reach the account's own address?
AUTH 8 — Can control be handed back cleanly?
